title: 覆盖谁,怎么适用

rows.label: 受灾范围
rows.note: 完整名单以 irs.gov 公告 HI-2026-01 为准。

rows.label: 适用方式
rows.note: IRS 存档地址在受灾范围内的,不必提出申请。

rows.label: 覆盖起点
rows.value: 2026 年 3月10日 起到期的联邦申报与缴款

callout.label: 这种情形要主动打电话
callout.body: 客户地址在受灾范围外,但账册或记账人在范围内 —— 需致电 IRS 特别服务专线 866-562-5227 申请,不会自动适用。代 10 个以上客户申请的,可走批量请求。

title: A federal deadline
has moved in this state
sub: 4 Hawaii counties. Automatic for an IRS address of record.

title: Who is covered, and how it applies

rows.label: COVERED AREA
rows.note: The full list is the one in IRS relief notice HI-2026-01.

rows.label: HOW IT APPLIES
rows.note: The IRS identifies taxpayers whose address of record sits in the area.

rows.label: COVERS FROM
rows.value: Federal returns and payments due on or after Mar 10, 2026

callout.label: This case needs a phone call
callout.body: A client outside the area whose records or preparer are inside it is not covered automatically — call IRS Special Services on 866-562-5227. Firms holding records for ten or more clients can use the bulk request route.
